projectStory.title: One question. Too many tabs. One open campus.
projectStory.origin: Sound familiar? You need to understand something, open a video, find the docs, watch another lesson and suddenly have dozens of tabs with no clear map.
projectStory.mission: FACODI adds context to those discoveries by connecting public resources with topics, courses and curricular units. Everyone can help improve the trail; editorial review keeps it useful.
projectStory.line: Good knowledge gets even better when someone leaves a clearer route behind.
projectStory.ecosystemTitle: One network. Different roles. No blurred lines.
projectStory.ecosystemDescription: Academic references are not accreditation. Technical collaborators are not automatically owners. Creative inspiration is not a formal partnership. Each relationship is named for what it is.
projectStory.boundary: All public credits and relationships are backed by public sources. Unverified proposals and potential contributors are not displayed as confirmed partners.
projectStory.communityDescription: You don't need a title to contribute. A good reference, a thoughtful correction or a helpful idea can make a difference.

projectCommunity.title: Nobody learns alone. Good thing, too.
projectCommunity.lead: FACODI is an invitation to learn in public, share what works and leave a clearer learning route for someone else. No gatekeeping, no unnecessary fuss, with careful curation.
projectCommunity.note: A good connection matters most when it reaches someone.
projectCommunity.actionsTitle: There is more than one way in.

projectCommunity.degreeText: FACODI does not award degrees, credits or formal academic equivalence.
projectCommunity.ctaDescription: Start small. One well-contextualized resource may make learning easier for someone.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: What personal data FACODI processes, why, with which providers, for how long and how to exercise your rights under the GDPR.
privacy.lead: You can explore the catalogue without an account. When you create one, we only process the data needed to keep your study and review your contributions.
summary: No advertising, no analytics and no selling of data.
The public catalogue works without an account and without first-party cookies.
With an account, we keep your email, the name you give, your notes, your progress and the contributions you send.
We use providers outside the European Economic Area, including a database in the US. We explain which ones and why below.
You can ask to access, correct or delete your data at [hello@open2.tech](mailto:hello@open2.tech).

sections.title: Data controller
body: FACODI is an open digital campus and a personal project by Marcelo Santos. It began in the context of the SEA-EU Student-Led Projects 2026 and the University of the Algarve, while remaining independently managed.

Marcelo Santos is responsible for the project and is its publicly identified contact person. We do not publish a private address, tax identifiers, private contact details or server infrastructure details here. Any additional legally required identification will be addressed after the applicable requirements are verified. The project's academic origins do not make the University of the Algarve or SEA-EU responsible for data processing.
Privacy contact: [hello@open2.tech](mailto:hello@open2.tech). No data protection officer has been appointed; whether one is needed is being assessed.

sections.title: What data we process
body: We only process data that results from actually using the platform. We do not collect payment, location or contact-list data, we do not ask for special categories of data and we do not build advertising profiles.
items: Account: email address, name (optional), password (stored by Supabase Auth only in irreversibly hashed form and never visible to the team), internal identifier, sign-up and last sign-in dates, email confirmation and, when manually assigned, your editorial role.
Study: notes saved to your account, progress in video sequences (video, position and completion) and study module status.

Contributions: resource suggestions (link, metadata, optional note and licence declarations), submitted playlists, collaboration proposals (interest, motivation and optional portfolio) and the related editorial decisions and review notes.
Notifications: an email queue about the status of playlists you submit, which stores the recipient account identifier, not the email address.
Technical data: IP address, date and time, browser and requested pages, processed by our hosting and database providers in their operational and security logs.

Only on your device: language and theme (for the session only, unless you ask us to remember them) and notes written while signed out. They are not sent to FACODI until you sign in. See [Cookies and storage](/cookies).

sections.title: Purposes and legal bases
body: Each processing activity relies on a legal basis in Article 6 of the [General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR)](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX:32016R0679).

table.caption: Purposes, data and legal bases
rows: Create the account, authenticate and keep you signed in
Performance of a contract, namely the [Terms of Use](/terms) (Art. 6(1)(b))
Review suggestions and playlists and communicate the decision
Consent, which you can withdraw at any time (Art. 6(1)(a))
Protect the service, prevent abuse and apply submission limits
Legitimate interest in the security of the service and its users (Art. 6(1)(f))
Respond to legitimate requests from authorities

sections.title: Authentication and account
body: Authentication uses Supabase Auth with email and password and the PKCE flow. The session is kept in the browser's local storage and renewed automatically until you sign out.

Authentication uses infrastructure shared with another application in the same ecosystem; FACODI's educational data remains subject to separate access permissions. This information is not used for advertising.

Editor and administrator roles are assigned manually, never automatically. Data access is enforced in the database by row-level security rules: study notes are visible only to you, and contributions only to you and the editorial team reviewing them.

sections.title: Providers and external services
body: We rely on the providers below. Some process data on our behalf (processors); YouTube, GitHub and Zenodo are independent third parties with their own policies.

table.caption: Providers and external services
rows: Database, authentication, authentication emails and server functions. Infrastructure hosted in the United States.

IP address of whoever visits them

sections.title: International transfers
body: The database and authentication are hosted in the United States. Cloudflare runs a global network, and Resend, Vercel and Google are US-based companies. Your data may therefore be processed outside the European Economic Area.

These transfers must rely on a Chapter V GDPR mechanism, such as the adequacy decision for the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework where the provider is certified, or standard contractual clauses approved by the European Commission. The mechanism for each provider is still to be confirmed and will be listed here.

sections.title: Retention
items: Account, notes, progress and contributions: for as long as the account exists. When the account is deleted, its notes, suggestions, collaboration proposals and notifications are deleted automatically.
Approved playlists and content already part of the catalogue may be kept for editorial reasons. When you ask for deletion, we tell you what is kept and why.
Technical logs: for the periods each provider sets for operation and security.
Data on your device: until you clear it in your browser.
Maximum retention periods for inactive accounts are still to be defined.

sections.title: Your rights
body: Under Articles 15 to 22 GDPR, you may ask for access to your data, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing and portability, and object to processing based on legitimate interest. Where processing relies on consent, you can withdraw it at any time without affecting processing already carried out.

You can correct your name, email and password directly in [your profile](/profile). For other requests, write to [hello@open2.tech](mailto:hello@open2.tech) from the email linked to your account. We reply within one month, extendable in the cases set out in Article 12 GDPR.

sections.title: Deleting your account
body: The app does not have an account deletion button yet. Until it does, send your request to [hello@open2.tech](mailto:hello@open2.tech) from the account's email with the subject “Delete FACODI account”.

We confirm your identity before acting, delete the authentication account and the associated data described under “Retention”, and confirm completion by email. Notes stored only on your device are removed by clearing the site's data in your browser.

sections.title: Minors
body: FACODI does not verify the age of people who create an account. In Portugal, a minor's consent to information society services is only valid from the age of 13 (Article 16 of Law 58/2019). The minimum age to create an account and the rules for minors are still to be set in a legal review.

sections.title: Contact and complaints
body: For any privacy question, contact [hello@open2.tech](mailto:hello@open2.tech).
You have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority (Article 77 GDPR). In Portugal, this is the Comissão Nacional de Proteção de Dados ([CNPD](https://www.cnpd.pt)).

sections.title: Changes to this policy
body: We update this policy when the way FACODI works changes. The date at the top shows the latest review. Changes affecting data already collected will be flagged in the app before they apply.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.description: Conditions for accessing and using FACODI: open catalogue, accounts, contributions, editorial curation, third-party content and service limits.
terms.lead: The rules for using FACODI, written to be read: what we offer, what we ask of you and what happens to your contributions.
summary: Reading the catalogue is free and needs no account.
FACODI organises third-party resources; it is not an educational institution and does not issue certificates.
Nothing you send is published without editorial review.
Linked videos and websites belong to their authors and have their own rules.

sections.title: About FACODI
body: FACODI is an open digital campus that organises courses, curricular units, modules, learning sequences and external resources, making it easier to find quality academic material and see where each piece fits in a learning path.

This is a personal educational initiative by Marcelo Santos, developed in the context of the SEA-EU Student-Led Projects 2026 and the University of the Algarve. FACODI's curriculum structures are editorial reconstructions, not institutionally approved syllabuses, and do not award credits, degrees, certificates or equivalences.

sections.title: Accepting these terms
body: By creating an account or sending a contribution, you accept these terms. Browsing the catalogue without an account is subject to the same acceptable use rules.
We may update the terms when the service changes. The date at the top shows the version in force, and relevant changes will be flagged in the app.

sections.title: Access to the service
items: The published catalogue can be read free of charge, with no account and no paywall.
An account lets you save notes and progress, suggest resources, submit playlists and propose collaboration.
Using FACODI costs nothing. If that changes, it will be with prior notice and new terms.

sections.title: Your account
items: Use an email address you control and keep your password secret. Accounts are personal.
You can change your name, email and password in your profile and sign out of all devices.
Editor and administrator roles are assigned manually by the team and can be withdrawn.
We may suspend or close accounts used for abuse, fraud or breach of these terms, explaining why whenever possible.
You can stop using FACODI at any time and ask for your account to be deleted, as described in the [Privacy Policy](/privacy#deletion).

sections.title: Acceptable use
body: When using FACODI, you agree not to:
items: send content that is illegal, misleading, discriminatory, incites hatred or violence, or infringes the rights of others;
suggest links to pirated or malicious material, or material you have no right to share;
try to access data or areas without permission, bypass submission limits or disrupt the service;
harvest other people's data or use automated processes that overload the platform;
impersonate another person or institution.

sections.title: Contributions
body: You can suggest resources, submit YouTube playlists and propose collaboration. Each submission stays private between you and the editorial team until reviewed, and nothing is published automatically.

When suggesting a resource, accurately identify its licence and source. NC (non-commercial) or ND (no derivatives) restrictions can be submitted to the review queue, but are flagged for editorial assessment and may be rejected; submitting is not approval.

You keep the rights to what you create. By sending a contribution, you allow FACODI to store and review it and, if approved, to publish the link, title, description and metadata in the catalogue, attributed to the original source. Your name is only published as a credit with your confirmation.
Submission limits prevent abuse, for example three collaboration proposals every seven days.

sections.title: Curation and moderation
body: The editorial team decides what is published, based on curricular relevance, quality, licence and source. It may approve, reject or archive contributions and already published content.

When a contribution of yours is rejected or content is withdrawn, we give the reason in your personal area or by email whenever possible. You can ask for a new review at [hello@open2.tech](mailto:hello@open2.tech).
Content is archived rather than permanently deleted, to keep the editorial history.
To report illegal content or a copyright infringement, follow the procedure in [Copyright](/copyright#report).

sections.title: Third-party content and links
body: Much of the catalogue consists of videos hosted on YouTube and links to books, documentation and external websites. That content belongs to its owners and is subject to their own conditions, including the [YouTube Terms of Service](https://www.youtube.com/t/terms).
We select resources carefully, but we do not control external websites: they may change, become unavailable or contain errors. If you find a problem, let us know.

sections.title: Intellectual property
body: FACODI's identity and original materials have their respective creators and rightsholders, including Marcelo Santos and contributing authors. Publicly accessible code is not automatically licensed for reuse. Third-party material remains subject to its own rights and terms.
Details on licences, attribution and third-party content are in [Copyright](/copyright).

sections.title: Availability and liability
body: FACODI is a student-born educational project, provided as is. We work to keep it running well, but we do not guarantee continuous availability, freedom from errors or that content is complete and up to date. We may change, suspend or discontinue features.
FACODI material supports study and does not replace official sources from educational institutions. Always check study plans, dates and requirements with your institution.
Nothing in these terms excludes or limits liability that cannot be excluded or limited by law.

sections.title: Contact and problem resolution
body: For questions, technical issues or complaints about the service, write to [hello@open2.tech](mailto:hello@open2.tech). We try to resolve things directly first.

These terms are governed by Portuguese law, without prejudice to the mandatory rules of the country where the person accepting them lives. The competent court and any alternative dispute resolution bodies are still to be confirmed.

cookies.title: Cookies and storage
cookies.description: FACODI uses no first-party cookies, analytics or advertising. What is stored in your browser, why, and when your consent is needed.
cookies.lead: FACODI sets no first-party cookies and uses no analytics or advertising tools. We only store in your browser what is needed for what you ask and, if you allow it, your language and theme between visits.
summary: No analytics, advertising or social media cookies.
Your language and theme are only remembered between visits if you turn that option on. By default they last until you close the tab.
The YouTube player only loads when you press play.

sections.title: Our approach
body: Portuguese law (Article 5 of [Law 41/2004](https://diariodarepublica.pt/dr/detalhe/modificacoes/41-2004-480710)) requires prior consent to store or read information on your device, except where strictly necessary to provide a service you explicitly requested. The rule covers cookies and also the browser's local storage.

We assessed each item separately in the table below. The session, the sign-in security code and guest notes are strictly necessary to do what you ask. The language and theme you choose are kept, by default, only for the tab session: the Article 29 Working Party considers interface preferences requested by the user exempt when they last only for the session ([Opinion 04/2012](https://ec.europa.eu/justice/article-29/documentation/opinion-recommendation/files/2012/wp194_en.pdf), section 3.6). Remembering them between visits requires your consent, which you give by turning on “Remember language and theme in this browser” and withdraw by turning it off.

Because nothing that depends on consent is stored before you make that choice, we do not show a banner. If we ever add non-essential tools, such as usage statistics, they will only be switched on after you allow them, with accept and refuse options equally visible and a simple way to change your mind.

sections.title: YouTube videos
body: Before you press play, we only show the video thumbnail, which your browser fetches directly from YouTube's image servers (i.ytimg.com). This request sets no cookies through FACODI, but it reveals your IP address to Google.

When you press play, the player loads from youtube-nocookie.com, YouTube's privacy-enhanced mode. From then on, YouTube may store and read information in your browser under the [Google Privacy Policy](https://policies.google.com/privacy). FACODI has no access to that data.

sections.title: Other third-party requests
body: When you suggest a resource, your browser queries YouTube oEmbed, the GitHub API or Zenodo to preview the title and author. These requests are made without credentials or cookies.

The application is served by Cloudflare. In the check on 15 November 2026, responses from facodi.com set no cookies. If Cloudflare ever applies technical anti-abuse cookies, they will be strictly necessary and listed here.
Fonts are hosted by FACODI itself and are not requested from external services.

sections.title: How to manage or delete
items: Signing out removes the session from your browser.
You can change the language and theme in the header or in your profile. By default, your choice lasts until you close the tab.

To remember your language and theme between visits, turn on the option below, also available in your profile. When you turn it off, we delete the stored preferences; the current language and theme stay until you close the tab.
If you block browser storage, some preferences may not be saved and sign-in may not work. Browsing the public catalogue does not require an account session.

copyright.title: Copyright and content
copyright.description: Who owns FACODI content and linked resources, how licences work, how to cite and how to report a copyright infringement.
copyright.lead: FACODI organises knowledge produced by many people. This page explains what is ours, what belongs to others and how to ask for content to be reviewed.
summary: Linked videos and resources still belong to their authors.
We only show a licence when the source declares one; we never assume an open licence.
You can ask for content to be reviewed or removed by email.

sections.title: Original FACODI content
body: Editorial texts and materials created for FACODI, catalogue curation, design and code may have different authors and rightsholders, including Marcelo Santos and their contributors. FACODI is a personal project by Marcelo Santos, not a legal entity that automatically owns all content. Reuse depends on the applicable licences or permissions.

The licence for this content is still to be confirmed. Until it is published, the general rules of the Portuguese Code of Copyright and Related Rights apply: you may read and quote it, but extensive reproduction or adaptation requires permission.
Reference curricular plans are based on public information from educational institutions, which keep ownership of their documents. FACODI versions are not official documents.

sections.title: Third-party material
body: Videos, books, articles, documentation and websites listed in the catalogue belong to their authors and publishers. FACODI does not host copies of them: it links to the original source or embeds YouTube's official player.
Thumbnails, titles and short descriptions identify each resource and always point back to the source.

sections.title: Embedded videos
body: Videos play through the YouTube player, under YouTube's conditions and the embedding options chosen by their authors. We do not download, alter or re-host videos.
If the author removes or blocks a video, it can no longer be played on FACODI.

sections.title: Licences
body: Each resource shows its licence when the source declares one. When there is none, we show “The source does not state a licence”: it means we do not know the licence, not that the content is free to use.
The “Licence verified” badge means the editorial team confirmed the licence at the source. Licences can change, and the original source prevails.
Before reusing a resource beyond reading it, check the conditions at the original source.

sections.title: Attribution and citation
body: When using a third-party resource, cite the author, title, source and licence, as the original source requires.
To cite FACODI, give “FACODI — a project by Marcelo Santos”, the page title, URL and date accessed.

sections.title: Contributors' rights
body: When you suggest a resource or submit a playlist, you do not transfer any rights to FACODI. You declare that the link may be shared in an educational context and allow the link and its metadata to be published if approved.
Named collaboration credits are only published after the person's permission is confirmed.
If you are the author of a linked resource and would rather it did not appear on FACODI, tell us and we will remove the link.

sections.title: Report an infringement or ask for a review
body: If you believe content on FACODI infringes copyright or other rights, or is illegal, write to [hello@open2.tech](mailto:hello@open2.tech) with the subject “Copyright” and include:
items: the address of the FACODI page and, where relevant, the resource concerned;
the work or right you believe is infringed, and why;
whether you are the rights holder or act on their behalf;
your name and contact email;
a statement that the information is accurate and given in good faith.

sections.title: What happens next
body: We acknowledge receipt, review the request diligently and, where justified, archive the content or remove the link. We inform the person who made the request and, whenever possible, the contributor, explaining the decision.

If you disagree with the decision, you can ask for a new review through the same channel. This procedure follows the notice-and-action principles of the [Digital Services Act](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX:32022R2065).

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.description: FACODI's commitment to an inclusive experience: measures in place, known limitations and how to report difficulties.
accessibility.lead: Learning should not depend on your device, how you navigate or how you read. This page describes what we already do, what still falls short and how you can help.

sections.title: Commitment
body: We want everyone to be able to use FACODI, including people who navigate by keyboard only or use screen readers, magnification or reduced-motion settings.

Our reference is level AA of the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines ([WCAG 2.2](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/)). It is a working goal: FACODI has not yet been independently audited and we do not claim conformance.

sections.title: Legal framework
body: Portuguese [Decree-Law 83/2018](https://diariodarepublica.pt/dr/detalhe/modificacoes/83-2018-116734769), which requires an accessibility statement, applies to public sector websites. Based on the information available, FACODI is not maintained by a public sector body; this depends on the controller's legal form, which is still to be confirmed.

The European Accessibility Act, transposed in Portugal by Decree-Law 82/2022, covers certain products and services, such as e-commerce. FACODI is free and sells no products or services, so it is unlikely to apply; this point is subject to legal review.
Regardless of any legal obligation, we follow these good practices voluntarily.

sections.title: Measures in place
items: A skip-to-content link and a structure with semantic headings, landmarks and lists.
Full keyboard navigation with always-visible focus.
Minimum text contrast of 4.5:1 in light and dark themes; content-type colours always come with a written label.
Respect for the system's reduced-motion setting.
Forms with labels, announced error messages and explained validation.
Icon-only buttons with accessible names; decorative images ignored by screen readers.
Interface in Portuguese, English, Spanish and French, with the page language exposed to the browser.
A video player that only loads when you ask, with YouTube's controls, including captions when the author provides them.
Automated axe-core tests (WCAG 2.1 A and AA criteria) on public pages, included in the project's test suite.

sections.title: Known limitations
items: External videos and websites are not controlled by FACODI: many videos have no reviewed captions or transcript.
Some editorial pages have dense tables and lists that can be hard to use on small screens or with screen readers.
Automated tests only cover some pages and do not replace testing with disabled people.
External documents, such as PDFs, may not be accessible.

sections.title: Report a difficulty
body: If something on FACODI stops you from accessing content or completing a task, write to [hello@open2.tech](mailto:hello@open2.tech) with the subject “Accessibility”. Tell us the page, what you tried to do and, if you like, the device, browser and assistive technology you use.
We try to fix the problem or provide the information another way, and we give these requests priority.

collectionPlaylists.title: Video learning paths in this collection
collectionPlaylists.notice: Sequences curated by FACODI using lessons from their original creators. Open a path to follow the proposed lesson order.

moduleResources.sequenceNotice: Lessons grouped by FACODI into a suggested progression. Videos remain with their original creators.
moduleResources.noSequences: No video sequences have been linked to this module.
moduleResources.readingsNotice: Access documentation and references through their original sources.
moduleResources.noReadings: No further reading has been linked to this module.
moduleResources.progressionNotice: Conceptual recommendations by FACODI, not official academic prerequisites.

editorSequenceOrder.title: Video lesson order
editorSequenceOrder.description: Curate each sequence without replacing videos, changing course links or losing learners' progress.
editorSequenceOrder.notFound: This sequence is not available for editing.
editorSequenceOrder.instructions: Drag lessons into order, or use the up and down buttons with a keyboard or on mobile. Changes are published only after confirmation.
editorSequenceOrder.conflict: Someone has changed this sequence. Reload the latest version before saving.
editorSequenceOrder.confirmDescription: The new order will change {{count}} positions for all learners. Existing videos and personal progress are preserved.

collectionModules.title: Modules and learning paths in this collection
collectionModules.notice: Open a module to follow its video sequences and browse related source material.

studyPath.title: Recommended learning path
studyPath.intro: One learning path with thematic sections. Videos belong to their original creators and supplement rather than replace institutional teaching.
studyPath.progressNote: Sign in to track your progress.
studyPath.sourceNotice: This is a supplementary editorial sequence. FACODI does not claim these are official lectures or that every video has been fully reviewed.
studyPath.practiceDescription: Apply your knowledge using the existing study guide's practical task and self-assessment criteria.
studyPath.extraDescription: Optional advanced sequences and resources, separate from the main path.
studyPath.loadFailed: Unable to load the learning path.
studyPath.unavailable: This learning path has changed and needs editorial review. The original sequence is still available.

composedPath.title: Recommended study journey
composedPath.description: One thematic roadmap composed of existing sequences. Each sequence retains its lessons and individual progress.
composedPath.extraDescription: Optional material outside the recommended path.
composedPath.progressNotice: Progress is saved within each sequence when signed in. These materials supplement, rather than replace, official teaching.
composedPath.libraryNote: Includes every video directly linked to the unit, including those also used in the pathways above. Nothing has been removed.

ualgCurriculum.licenceNotice: 2026/27 curriculum: each elective group offers alternative units. These options must not be added together when calculating the programme's 180 ECTS.
ualgCurriculum.masterNotice: Official 2026/27 plan: choose a specialization. Cognitive Neuroscience ends with a 60-ECTS dissertation; Neuropsychology with a 30-ECTS internship and a 30-ECTS dissertation. Electives and repeated listings must not be added together.
ualgCurriculum.choicesNotice: These are alternative units within the same elective group. Refer to the official curriculum to verify the selection rules.
ualgCurriculum.variantsNotice: The official plan also lists this entry under another name or code. Do not count its ECTS twice; confirm equivalence with the university.
ualgCurriculum.verifiedTrack: Completion route in the official plan
ualgCurriculum.ectsPending: ECTS to be confirmed by UAlg
